name: Approvals badge (axHub approvals + held calls in any title bar, click to decide)
description: Everything axHub is waiting on, for any AXF app's title bar (Brett, Oct 28 2026: "Make approvals pop up in the assistant's title bar, click to approve"). One list from the hub's approvals feed with the app's own hub session (lib-hub's read rules): calls waiting for an approval (title and description from the caller's reason, tool, age, approval link, the hub's decisions) and held veto@1 calls (live countdown, Deny only, never Approve). Live: polled every 5 s while the page is visible, on focus, on the axf:hub-check event and on a push (the hub has no approvals event stream yet). The badge shows the count and draws nothing when nothing waits; its popover lists each item with Approve / Decline or Deny, a result toast and All approvals on axHub. Deciding: the app's own path (setApprovalsHost decide, e.g. the AmberX phone's hub web view and native Deny), directly from a page on the hub's own origin (POST /auth/api/approvals/<id> with CSRF, veto Deny), the hub's approval page framed inside the popover where the hub allows it (AXHUB_APPROVALS_FRAME_ANCESTORS), else the page opens. requestApprovalsOpen(id) opens the popover from a notification tap. No new contract (approval-badge@1 was skipped): built over lib-hub hub.ts + veto.ts. Built Oct 28 2026 (Opus).
